ideas.pitch: A local LLM-powered assistant designed specifically for Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges that analyzes binary headers and network pcaps while preventing prompt-injection escalation.
ideas.title: Agentic CTF Assistant with Defense-in-Depth Hardening
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced security engineering by applying layered prompt-injection hardening and local tool calling directly tailored for a cybersecurity competition context.

ideas.pitch: A ZK-gated verification portal that allows verified cybersecurity club members to access sensitive challenge flags without exposing personal institutional credentials.
ideas.title: Zero-Knowledge Credential Gater for Digital Defence Clubs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes cryptographic privacy primitives (Noir-lang circuits) which appeals heavily to a specialized audience of cybersecurity enthusiasts and judges.

ideas.pitch: A Python-based CLI tool that scans participant repositories during CTF event teardown to automatically extract, summarize, and report security misconfigurations and hardcoded secrets.
ideas.title: RepoSec: Automated Security Insight and Vulnerability Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete operational problem for club organizers holding local security competitions by automating repository risk inspection.

ideas.pitch: A real-time detection dashboard that filters out malicious phishing payloads and social engineering attack vectors from competition submission channels using a fine-tuned transformer model.
ideas.title: BERT-Powered Phishing and Exploit Payload Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven spam and threat detection architectures to handle malicious text inputs typical in defensive security scenarios.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic engagement-gated simulation framework for tactical network recon scripts that enforces strict human-in-the-loop validation before executing exploit payloads.
ideas.title: Edge-Guarded Autonomous Reconnaissance Drone Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies defense-tech engineering standards with a clear human-in-the-loop safety boundary that safety-conscious judges appreciate.
